chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the minimum in which a woman may perform salat (prayer).
He said: “A dirʿ and a milḥafah; she spreads it over her head and wraps herself with it.”

key_terms.أَدْنَى: the minimum or least amount required
key_terms.تَتَجَلَّلُ: she covers or wraps herself completely
key_terms.دِرْعٌ: a garment or shift worn on the body
key_terms.مِلْحَفَةٌ: an outer wrap or sheet used for covering

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum clothing a woman needs for salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum clothing in which a woman may validly perform salat (prayer). Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام mentions a garment and an outer wrap that covers her head and with which she envelops herself, indicating the required level of covering for prayer.
